_comment: Hierarchical AllToAll on the SINGLE-PLANE rail-optimized 256-GPU cluster (300 fine nodes -> 44 coarse: 32 host cells + 8 leaves + 4 spines). Topology comes from teccl/topologies/topology-dsl-frontend/examples/rail_optimized_256gpu.topo; the path is relative to the repo root, i.e. to the directory `teccl solve` runs from. This is the NON-BLOCKING counterpart of rail_optimized_256gpu_dual_plane_hierarchical_alltoall.json (same 32x8 GPUs, same 8 leaves / 4 spines, same 1800 GB/s NVSwitch inside a host); the two differ only in the fabric cut -- one 400 Gbps rail per GPU into a non-blocking spine tier here, versus 2x400 Gbps into a 2:1 tapered spine tier there.
_expected: At chunk_size = 1 GB per (src,dst) GPU pair, each GPU ships 248 GB across the host boundary (255 peers - 7 host-mates that stay on the NVSwitch). Binding cut is the GPU RAIL: 248 GB / 50 GB/s = 4.96 s, i.e. 400 GB/s of host egress against 1984 GB per host. The spine cut is SLACK, as a non-blocking fabric should be: each leaf carries 32 x 217 GB = 6944 GB of up-traffic (217 = 248 - the 31 same-rail peers that turn around on the leaf) against 4 x 400 = 1600 GB/s of uplink = 4.34 s. So T* >= 4.96 s = 4 pinned epochs, and the leaf->spine tier should never be the reason a solution slips.
_epoch_note: epoch_duration is PINNED to 1.28 s at EVERY level (scalar USER_INPUT), the same quantum the dual-plane siblings pin, so the single-plane and dual-plane runs are comparable epoch for epoch. Left on FASTEST_LINK the root would derive the coarse chunk (2048 GB, a host's whole send buffer) over the 400 GB/s coarse leaf-spine link = 5.12 s -- a single epoch for the entire collective, which quantizes the answer into uselessness. At 1.28 s the 4.96 s bound lands at 4 epochs = 5.12 s, within 3% of the cut. A LONGER-than-fastest-link pin is always safe; a shorter one is refused at the closed-form levels by hierarchy/solve.level_epoch_duration (use the per-level list form, e.g. epoch_type [3, 1] with epoch_duration [x, -1], to pin only the root, which is the level solved by a real formulation).
